TitleHold.Name: Title card duration (seconds)
TitleHold.Hint: How long a place's title card stays on screen before it fades out.

SoundFade.Name: Default sound fade (seconds)
SoundFade.Hint: Fade applied to a linked sound the first time it is used, if the sound has no fade of its own.

Fade.Name: Fade by default
Fade.Hint: Starting state of the Fade checkbox in the Theater panel.

ClearCast.Name: Clear cast when changing place
ClearCast.Hint: Starting state of the “Clear cast on new place” checkbox in the Theater panel.

OptimizeOnAdd.Name: Optimize images when adding
OptimizeOnAdd.Hint: When you add places, heavy images (PNG, or over 1 MB) get a lighter WebP copy first. The originals are not changed.

Optimize.Title: Optimize images
Optimize.Body: Heavy images on this scene (PNG, or over 1 MB) get a lighter WebP copy, up to 2560 px wide, and the Theater uses the copy. Players download a fraction of the size; on screen it looks the same.
Optimize.Note: The original files stay where they are. “Restore originals” puts them back on this scene.

Audit.Title: Asset audit
Audit.FilesHint: Every image, sound and video the world's documents and settings use, biggest first. Heavy files slow down joins and scene changes for every player. Hover the count to see where a file is used.
Audit.OptimizeHint: Make a lighter WebP copy and use it everywhere this image is used. The original stays.
Audit.RepointHint: Replace this file with another one everywhere it is used.
Audit.NoGain: The WebP copy would not be much smaller, so the image was left as it is.
Audit.CantOptimize: This image can't be optimized here (it is on another server).
Audit.RepointBody: Replace “{from}” with “{to}” in all {count} place(s) that use it?
Audit.WorldSummary: World data: about {total}. Every player downloads all of it when they join.
Audit.WorldHint: Imports (Plutonium, compendium drags) pile up here. Actors and items nobody uses at the table can move to a compendium: they stay one drag away but are no longer sent to every player. Anything on a scene, owned by a player, in a combat or linked from a journal, a macro or a module stays.
Audit.MoveBody: Move {count} document(s) ({size}) into the “Planar Archive” compendium and delete them from the world? You can import them back from the compendium at any time.
Audit.Moved: Moved {count} document(s) to the Planar Archive compendium.

Keep.Linked: Linked from a journal, macro or module
